'''Star Tours Flight 611''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight was on time, but its gate was changed from Gate 1K to Gate 2M. It was expected to arrive at the spaceport at 1005 hours, and depart again at 1100.
